Latin word

vicis

vicis, vicem, vice; pl. vicēs, vicibus f.

noun, third declension, no nominative singular

a turn; one’s turn in a succession

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. BG 7.85.5; 4.1.5 (Lewis & Short, s.v. invicem)
